entities.summary: Baldassare Reina is an Italian Catholic prelate who has served as vicar general of the Diocese of Rome since 2024. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop there from 2022 to 2024. He also served in his native Archdiocese of Agrigento for nine years as rector of the major seminary. Pope Francis made him a cardinal in 2024. He was made grand chancellor of the John Paul II Pontifical Theological Institute for Marriage and Family Sciences by Pope Leo XIV in 2025.
